answer: Duplicate identities become unprofitable because forging a fresh credential costs more than the marginal reward, thinning the attacker pool like a drop in the ocean. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-work staking tied to unique physical resources: each agent must burn compute to mint a signed quill credential, and registration cost rises steeply as identity count climbs toward the zenith of allowed participants. Honest agents recover costs via epoch rewards; attackers drown in cumulative expense. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
